trigger: Service of the written notice of the petition; runs before the hearing on the petition
applies_to: Written notice to the respondent of a petition to compel arbitration
notes: Text does not say the court may shorten or extend; case law not reviewed. Same in HTM. Service per the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure.

period: on or before the return day of the notice of application
trigger: Return day stated in the notice of the petition
applies_to: Demand for a jury trial on whether the agreement was made or there is a default
binds: Party alleged to be in default (respondent)
notes: Not available in admiralty cases. Return day is set by the notice, so the date is variable. Same in HTM.

applies_to: Application to the specified (or default) court for an order confirming the award
notes: Applies where the parties agreed judgment may be entered on the award. Text gives no extension. Same in HTM. Notice must then be served on the adverse party (no period stated).

period: time fixed by the arbitration agreement for making the award (not stated in statute)
applies_to: Court's discretionary direction of a rehearing by arbitrators
notes: Court has discretion whether to order rehearing, but only if the contractual period has not expired. Section 10 itself sets no deadline to move to vacate; see § 12. Same in HTM.

applies_to: Serving notice of a motion to vacate, modify or correct the award
binds: Moving party (any party seeking vacatur/modification) serving the adverse party or its attorney
notes: Text says service, not filing, must occur in the period; no extension stated. Same in HTM. Service rules differ for resident and nonresident adverse parties (no period).

period: time for making the award, as set by agreement and any written extension
trigger: Agreement or written extensions by the parties
applies_to: Moving party must file the agreement and any written extensions with the clerk when the order is filed
binds: Party moving to confirm, modify or correct
notes: Not a statutory limit; it recognizes contractual time limits and their extensions. Included for completeness. Same in HTM.

applies_to: Title does not apply to contracts made before that date
notes: Historical cut-off; of little practical effect. Same in HTM.

applies_to: Removal of a state action relating to a Convention arbitration agreement or award
notes: Open-ended window ending at trial; ordinary removal procedure otherwise applies (28 U.S.C. timing not addressed here). Same in HTM. Chapter 3 incorporates 205 via § 302.

applies_to: Application to a court for an order confirming the award against another party
notes: Applies also to Inter-American Convention awards via § 302. No extension in text. Same in HTM.

trigger: Date the Commission promulgated its rules
applies_to: Identifies the version of IACAC rules that governs under chapter 3
notes: Not a deadline. Under § 306(b) the Secretary of State may by regulation make later amendments effective. Same in HTM.
